explanation: States that a(n), the number of distinct length-n factors of the fixed point of a→aab, b→b, equals the n-th coefficient of 1/(1−x) + x/(1−x)²·(1/(1−x) − Σ_{k≥0} x^(2^(k+1)+k)). This is not literally Ralf Stephan's OEIS g.f. "1 + 1/(1-x) + 1/(1-x)^2·[1/(1-x) − Σ_{k≥1} x^(2^k+k−1)]". The OEIS expression, read with offset 0, gives 3, 4, 6, 9, …, i.e. it is shifted by two (it starts at a(2)). I checked numerically that the Lean expression yields 1, 2, 4, 6, 9, 13, 17, 22, 28, …, which matches the OEIS data and the Allouche–Shallit formula Σ_{i=0}^{n} min(2^i, n−i+1) for n < 25. So the formalization is a sensible correction of the off-by-offset g.f., and the reindexing of the sum is correct. The infinite word is correctly defined as the limit of prefixes (each iterate is a prefix of the next), and a(0) = 1 counts the empty word. Severity 1, though the docstring could note that it adjusts the OEIS g.f.
